[To [Gertrude Mary Ireland Blackburne](/person/160)]I can’t help being attracted by ghost discussions, and there are some things that I very decidedly believe.
I don’t care much for [Nuttie](/book/183) myself. I am getting too old to write of the swing of modern life; I don’t see enough of it.
